Definition: from G3825 and G1078; (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e. (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, Messianic restoration:--regeneration.
BiblicalUsage: Palingenesia is rebirth, regeneration, spiritual renovation. Jesus promises that in the regeneration, when the Son of man sits on the throne of His glory, the twelve shall sit on twelve thrones judging the tribes of Israel, and Paul says God saved us by the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Ghost.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe regeneration is both a washing and a world made new. God washes me now, and in the end He washes the whole creation.
